name: New Zealand
law: Duty and GST are only collected at the border on parcels worth over NZ$1,000. Below that, the overseas shop charges GST at checkout and nothing is collected at the border, except on alcohol and tobacco.

questions.prompt: Does the caller say a tax, duty or customs charge (such as VAT, GST or import tax) must be paid before a parcel is delivered?

options.text: Yes: a tax, duty or customs charge to pay before delivery

questions.prompt: What is in the parcel, and what is it worth?

options.text: Worth more than 1,000 New Zealand dollars
Worth 1,000 New Zealand dollars or less

rules.label: scam
rules.why: New Zealand collects duty and GST at the border only on parcels worth over NZ$1,000. Below that the overseas shop charges GST at checkout and nothing is collected at the border, so this tax doesn't exist and the payment page is a trap.
rules.advice: Don't pay. Track the parcel on the courier's own website, typed in yourself.

rules.label: legit
rules.why: New Zealand collects duty and GST at the border on parcels worth over NZ$1,000, and on alcohol and tobacco whatever their value, so a charge before delivery is expected.

rules.label: unsure
rules.why: In New Zealand a charge at the border is real only on parcels worth over NZ$1,000, or on alcohol and tobacco, and the call doesn't say what this parcel is or what it's worth.
rules.advice: Check what you paid for it: at NZ$1,000 or less, nothing is due at the border.
